descriptionChirho: All three clusters refer to the single concept of blood (literal or figurative/sacrificial). The multilingual evidence is completely uniform: English 'blood / bloods / in blood' all denote the same substance, Spanish 'sangre / sangres / en sangre', Arabic 'دم / دماء / بدم' (blood / bloods / with blood), Korean '피' throughout all clusters, Hindi 'लहू' (blood) in all three, and Swahili 'damu' (blood) throughout. S61413 is merely the genitive plural and S61416 is a dative singular prepositional form. These are purely inflectional variants of the single lexeme, not distinct senses.
